BL-1467 — The post-land re-point (BL-1438) resets the QA branch to origin/main and silently drops committed local-only work its guards never see - a bounce's evidence and bounce_history commits for another ticket, the BL-490/495 revert, a follow-up finding (BL-1450's, 2026-09-07 after BL-1447's land; survived only in the reflog); the re-point re-applies bookkeeping commits for tickets other than the landed one and names every commit it drops
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-07 by the specifier on QA's note, the same pass, with
BL-1466 (the land-time half). The two are independent: BL-1466 keeps
bounced content off main whatever the branch holds; this ticket keeps
QA's evidence trail intact and makes the re-point's drops visible.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. What is FIRM: BL-1438's promises stand (guards unchanged, a skip never fails a land, once per land after LAND_PUBLISHED); bookkeeping co…
BL-1467 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1467" (or "reject BL-1467 <reason>") to act.
